Saturday, Sunday, and Monday mornings at 10:30 am

Every Saturday, Sunday, and Monday morning, join our children's booksellers as they read their favorite picture books. We'll explore faraway places and visit cozy, comfortable spots. We'll go back in time, visit the future, and celebrate the present through new books and beloved classics. These are fun for all ages! 

Duration: 30 minutes. Note: Please plan to stay with your child. Park strollers outside of the store so that we'll have room for all!

NOTE: Storytime is suspended from Thanksgiving through New Year's. We will resume regular storytime the Saturday after New Year's Day.
